tools.description: Every destination NUM covers, with its country. Use a destination's name or slug as num_search_places city. Free, unmetered, and needs no key.

tools.name: num_submit_business
tools.description: Submit a business to NUM for review. Free and unmetered. A person at 5arz reviews every submission before any traveller sees it, so the result is status 'pending_review', never an immediate listing. tools.name: num_submit_promo
tools.description: Attach a promotion, special, event or ad to a business previously submitted by the same account. Free and unmetered. A person reviews it before it is shown to anyone. Re-sending the same promo_ref updates the pending promotion instead of creating a duplicate.

tools.name: num_list_submissions
tools.description: Lists the businesses and promotions this account has submitted, with the reviewer's decision on each. Free and unmetered.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: num_get_place, num_search_photos · Private data: num_get_place, num_submit_business, num_license_photo, num_photo_wallet · Public sink: num_get_place, num_submit_business, num_submit_promo, num_search_photos, num_photo_wallet · Destructive: num_search_photos, num_license_photo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: num_get_place, num_search_photos · Private data: num_get_place, num_submit_business, num_license_photo, num_photo_wallet · Public sink: num_get_place, num_submit_business, num_submit_promo, num_search_photos, num_photo_wallet · Destructive: num_search_photos, num_license_photo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
